messages.subject: Trying to learn shiny modules
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

I am working on an app and I quickly realized it was going to become pretty large and complex. I began thinking about how it would be great to be able to modularize it and reuse the modules and after some research, I discovered this is possible! I am taking a stab and changing the first iteration of my app to use modules but I am stuck. I have read through all of the articles I can find and watched a few videos, but all of the examples I have found so far build a rather simple app, so I hope someone here is able to help. I have my ui.r, server.r, CFNavbarTab.r, and CFData.r files. I plan to have several navbarMenus with tabPanels so my goal was to modularize as much of the tabPanel as possible. There error I am getting is the "Warning: Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext: Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive expression or observer.)" so I know I am missing a reactive expression somewhere. I am having trouble with the logic around how to use renderUI for a dynamic selectInput as well as filtering on multiple ui inputs. Here is the code so far:

ui.r
library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(shinythemes)
source("CFNavbarTab.r")
source("CFData.r")

shinyUI(fluidPage(shinythemes::themeSelector(),
                  titlePanel("Cluster Capacity Dashboard"),
                  navbarPage("NavBar",
                             navbarMenu("RAM",
                                        tabPanel("Availability Difference (Large)", CFNavbarTabUI("ram.lg")),
                                        tabPanel("Availability Difference (Small)", CFNavbarTabUI("ram.sm <http://ram.sm>"))
                             ),
                             navbarMenu("CPU",
                                        tabPanel("Availability Difference (Large)", CFNavbarTabUI("cpu.lg")),
                                        tabPanel("Availability Difference (Small)", CFNavbarTabUI("cpu.sm <http://cpu.sm>"))
                             )
                             )
)
)

server.r
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
source("CFNavbarTab.r")
source("CFData.r")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  callModule(CFNavbarTab, "ram.lg", ram.lg.data)
  callModule(CFNavbarTab, "ram.sm <http://ram.sm>", ram.sm.data)
  callModule(CFNavbarTab, "cpu.lg", cpu.lg.data)
  callModule(CFNavbarTab, "cpu.sm <http://cpu.sm>", cpu.sm.data)

  })

CFData.r
library(dplyr)

# Data import
  setwd("~/TDP/CPF_Analytics/")
  k8s_ram_cpu_report <- read.csv("k8s_ram_cpu_report.csv")
  k8s_cluster_opt_app_sizes <- read.csv("k8s_cluster_opt_app_sizes.csv")
  df.RAMCPU <- mutate(k8s_ram_cpu_report, RAM.AVAILABLE.GB = RAM.AVAILABLE / 1000000000) %>% mutate(RAM.ACTUAL.GB = RAM.ACTUAL / 1000000000)
  df.OPTAPP <- k8s_cluster_opt_app_sizes
  df.fullJoin <- full_join(df.OPTAPP, df.RAMCPU,  by = c("CLUSTER" = "CLUSTER.NAME <http://CLUSTER.NAME>"))

  CF.df <- reactive ({

    if (input$ui.usage == "All"){
      df.USAGE <- df.RAMCPU$USAGE
      df.USAGE
    }
    else {
      df.USAGE <- input$ui.usage
    }

    if (is.null(input$ui.environment)){
      df.ENVIRONMENT <- df.RAMCPU$ENVIRONMENT
      df.ENVIRONMENT
    }
    else {
      df.ENVIRONMENT <- input$ui.environment
    }

    if (is.null(input$ui.dataCenter)){
      df.GEOLOC <- df.RAMCPU$GEOLOC
      df.GEOLOC
    }
    else {
      df.GEOLOC <- input$ui.dataCenter
    }

    CF.df <- data %>% dplyr::filter(USAGE == df.USAGE, ENVIRONMENT == df.ENVIRONMENT, GEOLOC == df.GEOLOC)

  })

  ram.lg.data <- select(CF.df(), CLUSTER.NAME, RAM.AVAILABLE.GB, RAM.ACTUAL.GB)
  ram.lg.data <- mutate(ram.lg.data, RAM.DIFFERENCE = RAM.AVAILABLE.GB - RAM.ACTUAL.GB) %>%
    arrange(desc(RAM.DIFFERENCE)) %>%
    head(n = 20) %>%
    select(CLUSTER.NAME, RAM.AVAILABLE.GB, RAM.ACTUAL.GB)
  ram.lg.data <- melt(ram.lg.data)
  reactive(ram.lg.data)

  ram.sm.data <- select(CF.df(), CLUSTER.NAME, RAM.AVAILABLE.GB, RAM.ACTUAL.GB)
  ram.sm.data <- mutate(ram.sm.data, RAM.DIFFERENCE = RAM.AVAILABLE.GB - RAM.ACTUAL.GB) %>%
    arrange(RAM.DIFFERENCE) %>%
    head(n = 20) %>%
    select(CLUSTER.NAME, RAM.AVAILABLE.GB, RAM.ACTUAL.GB)
  ram.sm.data <- melt(ram.sm.data)
  reactive(ram.sm.data)

  cpu.lg.data <- select(CF.df(), CLUSTER.NAME, CPU.AVAILABLE, CPU.ACTUAL)
  cpu.lg.data <- mutate(cpu.lg.data, CPU.DIFFERENCE = CPU.AVAILABLE - CPU.ACTUAL) %>%
    arrange(desc(CPU.DIFFERENCE)) %>%
    head(n = 20) %>%
    select(CLUSTER.NAME, CPU.AVAILABLE, CPU.ACTUAL)
  cpu.lg.data <- melt(cpu.lg.data)
  reactive(cpu.lg.data)

  cpu.sm.data <- select(CF.df(), CLUSTER.NAME, CPU.AVAILABLE, CPU.ACTUAL)
  cpu.sm.data <- mutate(cpu.sm.data, CPU.DIFFERENCE = CPU.AVAILABLE - CPU.ACTUAL) %>%
    arrange(CPU.DIFFERENCE) %>%
    head(n = 20) %>%
    select(CLUSTER.NAME, CPU.AVAILABLE, CPU.ACTUAL)
  cpu.sm.data <- melt(cpu.sm.data)
  reactive(cpu.sm.data)

CFNavbarTab.r
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

CFNavbarTabUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
               column(12,
                      column(3,
                             radioButtons(ns("ui.usage"), "Cluster Usage",
                                          c("All" = "All", "Dedicated"="Dedicated", "Shared"="Shared"), selected = "All"
                                         ),
                             callModule(dynamicSelectInput, data, "ui.environment"),
                             callModule(dynamicSelectInput, data, "ui.dataCenter")
                            ),
                      column(9,
                             plotOutput(ns("CF.plot"))
                            ),
                      column(12,
                             dataTableOutput(ns("CF.dt"))
                            )
                    )
    )
  )
}

CFNavbarTab <- function(input, output, session, data){

  # Plot
  output$CF.plot <- renderPlot({

    # Plot
    CF.p <- ggplot(data, aes(CLUSTER.NAME, value, fill = variable))
    CF.p +
      geom_bar(stat="identity",position="dodge") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Cluster Name", y = "RAM (in GB)")
  })

  # Datatable
  df.fullJoin <- select(data, CLUSTER, NODE, NODE_TYPE, STATUS, USAGE, OWNER.NAMESPACE, GEOLOC, ENVIRONMENT, RAM.AVAILABLE, RAM.ACTUAL, RAM.QUOTA)
  df.fullJoin$CLUSTER <- as.factor(df.fullJoin$CLUSTER)
  output$CF.dt <- renderDataTable(df.fullJoin, extensions = 'Buttons', rownames = FALSE, class = 'cell-border stripe', options = list(
    dom = 'Blfrtip', buttons = list('print', list(extend = 'collection', buttons = c('csv', 'excel', 'pdf'),
                                                  text = 'Download')), lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, -1)), filter = 'top')

  }

  # Dynamic selectInput
  dynamicSelectInputUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  uiOutput(ns("dynamicSelect"))
  }

  dynamicSelectInput <- function(input, output, session, data, name) {
  output$dynamicSelect <- renderUI({
    ns <- session$ns
    selectInput(ns("ui.selectInput"), name, data$ENVIRONMENT, multiple=TRUE, selectize=TRUE)
    })

  return(reactive({
    data[,input$ui.selectInput]
  })
  )
  }

  I realize that without data this is not reproduceable and I am working on making some dummy data to help troubleshoot my problem. Thanks!
